audited_candidate_bundle.ordered_manifest_hash_rule: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical minified ordered array of path,sha256,bytes rows

blockers.evidence: The exact primary wrapper now binds candidate, run, slot, cell, predeclared nonce, semantic packet, and dispatch-schedule storage identity. Seven structurally distinct old-candidate, cross-run, cross-slot, cross-cell, nonce, semantic-packet, and schedule mutations reject. Admission reads the canonical schedule before app-server creation, every completed receipt is reconstructed from primary bytes, and qualification requires different run IDs plus disjoint nonce sets. Reuse of an entire abandoned run ID and schedule remains outside the standalone verifier and requires create-only external custody.

Only response-item types message and reasoning are safe. Every other nonempty type and every missing or malformed payload is classified prohibited. The six self-test classes pass; two reopened real-schema examples independently classified custom_tool_call/output, tool_search_call/output, legacy call/output, and unknown agent_message as prohibited.

The current architecture, embedded bootstrap closure, independent projection, actual storage, and preflight open trace agree on the exact sorted 42-row external dependency closure: 28 inherited bindings, 11 frozen snapshot source files, and 3 candidate-v6 facade baselines. All 42 hash/byte pairs reopen exactly and no live Plans path is present.

blockers.title: External freeze validation does not bind the PASS audit's audited ten-file subject to the manifest's current candidate bytes
blockers.finding: validate_audit checks the audit identity, PRESEAL_PASS status, launch_ready, scope, zero-call fields, and the audit file's own manifest binding, but never reads or validates audited_candidate_bundle. validate_freeze_manifest separately compares manifest candidate_files to whatever eleven files are current at manifest creation. There is no equality check between the audit's ten path/hash/byte rows or ordered subject digest and the current non-audit candidate rows.
blockers.adversarial_result: After a genuine PASS audit, changing any non-audit candidate file and regenerating the external manifest around the changed current bytes leaves the old PASS audit acceptable to validate_audit. The freeze validator can therefore emit PASS for bytes that the independent audit never reviewed. This directly breaks the claimed exact-current-candidate audit-to-freeze custody boundary.
blockers.impact: A stale independent PASS can authorize an unaudited candidate mutation, so the external freeze, both run contracts, all admissions, and a nominal two-run qualification can share a manifest identity without proving that the executed candidate was the audited subject.
blockers.required_repair: In a create-only successor, make validate_audit require the exact audited_candidate_bundle schema and exact ten-file ordered path/hash/byte projection, recompute that projection from the current candidate directory excluding independent_preseal_audit.json, validate its canonical byte count and SHA-256, and require exact equality before any freeze PASS. Bind the same audited-subject digest explicitly in the external manifest and run-contract freeze identity.

passed_boundaries: The exact current ten-file candidate JSON and Python syntax pass strict duplicate-key and AST checks.
The stored deterministic preflight reproduced byte-for-byte with zero subject or provider calls.
Provider-visible semantic prompts, schedule, and semantic oracles are byte-identical for 97/97 cells; all 64 holdouts pass.
No answer literal or route/model/slot/cell answer special case was found in the candidate-v7 driver, wrapper, or verifier control layer.

The fail-closed response-item type classifier covers custom_tool_call/output, tool_search_call/output, unknown types, and malformed payloads; real stored schema examples classify the expected tool activity as prohibited.
The exact 42-row runtime dependency closure reopens 42/42 bytes, the actual preflight open trace contains 42 bound external paths, and no live Plans path is admitted.
The run and two-run schemas require exact 291-call matrices, 582 calls across two runs, disjoint nonce sets, and unique thread and turn identities.

residual_risks.statement: CSPRNG entropy quality and prelaunch persistence are external-controller/Git-checkpoint facts; the verifier proves only lowercase-hex-256 shape, uniqueness, schedule binding, and driver admission before app-server creation.

A standalone verifier has no global registry of abandoned run IDs and full schedules. Exact reuse of an entire prior candidate-v7 run identity remains dependent on create-only external run-root custody; qualification proves disjointness only for its two supplied roots.

No separate platform task_id, direct thread-create invocation receipt, provider-effective model or thinking attestation, or serving snapshot is exposed. Fresh task identity is the unique session/thread_id and its unique turn_id.

The fixture creator's no-scorer and no-prior-answer read history remains declarative; exact frozen bytes and source closures revalidate, but historical process blindness is not mechanically reconstructible.
root_controller_only and external create-only custody are protocol boundaries rather than authenticated operating-system writer identities.
